NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, November 21 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, November 21 · 4 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 21, 7:09 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, November 21 DraftKings main slate at 58.3 DraftKings points for $12,200. Cooper Flagg (DAL, 47.1, $9,700) and Jalen Brunson (NYK, 45.2, $9,100) are next.

Andre Drummond (NYK) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 8.11 projected points per $1,000 at $3,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 21, 7:09 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
